test_title: PYST 4: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

This book is (1) / gooder than (2) / the one we read (3) / last month(4).
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error is found in part (2) of the sentence and involves the incorrect formation of a **comparative adjective**.
 
• The adjective "**good**" is irregular. It does not follow the standard rule of adding "-er" to form its comparative degree.
 
• The correct comparative form of "good" is "**better**," and the superlative form is "**best**."
 
• Therefore, "gooder" is grammatically incorrect and must be replaced with "**better**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"This book is **better than** the one we read last month."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **(1): "This book is"** – This part is correct; it identifies the singular subject and the appropriate linking verb.
 
• **(3): "the one we read"** – This is a correct way to refer back to a previously mentioned noun ("book"). The verb "read" is in the past tense here (pronounced like "red").
 
• **(4): "last month."** – This is a standard adverbial phrase of time and is grammatically correct.
